name: Chandrayaan-2 (Vikram)

narrator.name: Vikram
narrator.role: the lander named after Vikram Sarabhai

intro: Namaste! I'm Vikram, India's first Moon lander, carrying the little rover Pragyan.
We're going far south, near the lunar south pole, where ice may hide in dark craters.
Landing there is hard: long shadows, rough highlands.
Mission control picked a main site and a backup. Help me decide!
briefing: Our descent is drifting off the planned path...
Choose the landing site before it's too late!
fact: Vikram crashed in 2019, but four years later Chandrayaan-3 landed nearby and succeeded.

alarm.title: Trajectory Deviation
alarm.alarm: DESCENT OFF PATH — BRAKING TOO HARD
alarm.briefing: The braking phase went wrong and we are tumbling off our path! In real life Vikram crashed. Choose a site and try to do better!

site.name: Highlands between Manzinus C and Simpelius N
